schools.inspectionPrecis: The Green School for Boys has taken effective action to maintain the standards identified at the previous inspection. The head of this school is Simon Carter. This school is part of The Green School Trust, which means that other people also have responsibility for running the school. The trust is run by the chief executive officer (CEO), Sally Yarrow, who is also the executive headteacher, overseeing this school and one other. The trust is overseen by a board of trustees, chaired by Charles Tapson.
